title: Pentaho Solution Architect - Containers Specialty
description: Deploy the Pentaho Server with containers and Kubernetes: build the EE image from a staged archive, run it with Podman Compose against PostgreSQL, then take the same deployment to K3s with raw manifests and Helm.

assistant.subject: deploying the Pentaho Server with containers (Podman image builds, Compose with PostgreSQL, K3s manifests and Helm)

moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: How to get the most out of this guide, and what to install up front - Podman Desktop, kubectl and Helm, plus the licensed Pentaho Server archive the image build stages.

moduleSummaries.title: Containers 101
moduleSummaries.summary: Runtimes, orchestration and where the Pentaho Server fits - the concepts behind everything you deploy in this course.

moduleSummaries.title: Build the Image
moduleSummaries.summary: Build a parameterised Pentaho Server EE image from a staged archive with the softwareOverride layer pattern, then smoke-test it with a throwaway compose file.

moduleSummaries.title: Compose Deployment
moduleSummaries.summary: Run the image against PostgreSQL 15 with Podman Compose - five repository databases, health checks, persistent volumes - and see what changes for MySQL, MSSQL and Oracle.

moduleSummaries.title: Kubernetes (K3s)
moduleSummaries.summary: Take the same deployment to a lightweight Kubernetes: namespaces, configmaps, storage, database and server manifests, deployed and torn down by script.

moduleSummaries.title: Helm
moduleSummaries.summary: Package the K3s deployment as a Helm release - install, upgrade and roll back from one chart.

moduleSummaries.title: High Availability
moduleSummaries.summary: Production HA from the installation guide: two Pentaho nodes behind an HAProxy pair with Keepalived VIP failover, a shared PostgreSQL 14 repository, the Jackrabbit cluster journal and Quartz clustering - plus Carte clustering for PDI execution and Tray.io driving event-based ETL through the Carte REST API.
